The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1947–1948''' was contested by 66 teams participating in six divisions. The national champion was determined by a play-off between the winners of the eastern, northern, two southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[FC Den Bosch|BVV Den Bosch]] won the championship by beating [[sc Heerenveen]], [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]], [[HFC EDO]], [[HFC Haarlem]] and [[PSV Eindhoven]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FC Zwolle|Zwolsche Boys]]
'''Eerste Klasse South-I:'''
*Moving in from South-II: [[FC Eindhoven]], [[Sittardse Boys]], [[Juliana (football club)|Juliana]], [[Maurits (football club)|Maurits]] and [[De Spechten]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VV TSC]]
'''Eerste Klasse South-II:'''
*Moving in from South-I: [[SC Helmondia]], [[NAC Breda|NAC]], [[NOAD (football club)|NOAD]], [[VC Vlissingen]] and [[VVV Venlo]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[HFC Haarlem]], [[SC Neptunus]] [[Volewijckers|De Volewijckers]] and [[XerxesDZB|Xerxes]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Zeeburgia]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[ADO Den Haag]], [[AFC DWS|DWS]], [[HFC EDO]], [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]] and [[Sparta Rotterdam]]
